title: IM39005: Quality Design And Control Laboratory
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: IM21003 Operations Research-1Exercises and experiments on
variability of quality characteristics, construction of control charts for
attributes and variables, work flow systems (push and pull types), analysis of
sampling plans with sampling simulators, development of life testing plans,
online quality control systems.
